name: Paradisus Playa del Carmen, La Esmeralda
positioning: All-inclusive resort in Playa del Carmen (officially Paradisus Playa del Carmen - Riviera Maya), set in a mangrove forest near the beach, with a water park, lagoon-style pools and Family Concierge suites
best_for: Families who want a water park, kids' activities and Family Concierge benefits
Travelers who want an all-inclusive stay with direct beach access and suites with terrace whirlpool tubs

facts.text: Paradisus Playa del Carmen is an all-inclusive resort.
The resort has direct access to the beach.
Beaches, coral reefs, cenote pools and Mayan ruins are found in nearby Playa del Carmen.
Family Concierge offers exclusive services and benefits designed for the whole family.
The Junior Suite Nature View has tropical-style furniture and a private terrace with garden views.
The Suite Nature View is a one-bedroom suite with a whirlpool tub on a garden-view terrace.
The Two Bedroom Master Suite Nature View has two terraces with a hydromassage tub and views of the resort's gardens.
Kids can take part in games and experiments that stimulate their curiosity and imagination.
The fitness center offers Pilates, yoga, spinning, wellness and massage classes.
The resort hosts weddings through Romance by Paradisus.
Kanna Beach Club is a beachfront restaurant with Bali beds on the sand and a DJ on weekends.
Cielo serves contemporary Mexican cuisine with a live-cooking quesadilla station.

highlights.text: The resort is located in a mangrove forest very near large beaches with fine, white sand.
The resort has a water park, lagoon-style pools, an activities pool and a swim-up bar.
The Family Concierge Junior Suite Swim Up has direct access to the pool from the terrace.
The YHI Spa offers body and facial treatments made with Mexican honey, essential oils and local ingredients.
A family party with music, snacks and bubbles is held daily in the resort's water park.

considerations.text: The yoga class at a Mayan cenote in the jungle is an offsite experience.
WhataHotel notes the large resort may feel crowded during peak seasons.
